description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter mobile application, including UI components such as the profile header, status card, quick actions grid, weather recommendations, and bottom navigation bar. It integrates localization, navigation, and state management to display restaurant information and facilitate user interactions within the app.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the application's home screen, showing restaurant status, user profile, quick actions, and navigation options.

classes.name: _ProfileHeader
classes.description: Widget displaying the restaurant profile information and story.

classes.name: _StatusCard
classes.description: Widget showing whether the restaurant is open or closed along with operating hours.

classes.name: _QuickActions
classes.description: Grid widget for quick navigation actions to different app sections.

classes.name: _ActionTile
classes.description: Individual tile for each quick action in the grid, with icon, label, and tap handler.

classes.name: _WeatherRecommendations
classes.description: Widget suggesting items based on weather conditions.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Bottom navigation bar allowing switching between main app sections.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for widget tree of each widget class.
